# semaphore_ex_project_template_version (Data Source)

Reads an immutable published template version and its content fingerprint. Omit version_number to select the latest published version. Reading never publishes a version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_template_version" "release" {
  project_id     = 1
  template_id    = 2
  version_number = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) Project owning the template.
- `template_id` (Number) Template whose versions to read.

### Optional

- `version_number` (Number) Exact published version number, or latest when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `content_fingerprint` (String) Immutable SHA-256 content fingerprint.
- `created` (String) Publication timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Server-assigned version record ID.
